PROP formula sheet On-design cycle analysis, propellers and turbomachinery

T1 on-design analysis (turbojet, turbofan, mixed turbofan and afterburner, turboshaft, turboprop, propfan), T2 compressors, T3 turbines. Formula sheet, 2 A4 sheets (4 faces). Formulas by topic, then data tables.

Gas, totals and mass flow

Cold gas (stations 0-3, 13-19): γc = 1.4, cp_c = 1004.5 J/(kg K), R_c = 287 J/(kg K). Hot gas (4-9): γt = 1.3, cp_t = 1239 J/(kg K), R_t = cp_t (γt-1)/γt = 285.9 J/(kg K). R_t applies at hot stations.

Station numbering (AS755)

0 freestream; 1 inlet entry; 2 inlet exit / fan face; 13 fan exit; 25 LPC exit / HPC entry; 3 HPC exit / burner entry; 4 burner exit / HPT vanes; 45 HPT exit / LPT entry; 5 LPT exit; 6, 16 mixer entry (core, fan duct); 6A mixer exit; 7 afterburner exit; 8 nozzle throat; 9 core exit; 19 fan exit.

Convergent nozzles: subsonic civil engines and fan streams (the fan nozzle is often unchoked at cruise). C-D nozzles: high nozzle pressure ratio (supersonic flight, afterburning), usually variable area.

Mixed exhaust, mixer and afterburner

Long-duct turbofan: fan duct πfd = Pt16/Pt13 = 0.98-0.99, τfd = 1. Kutta condition at the splitter: P6 = P16; design approximation Pt6 ≈ Pt16 closes the cycle, with α set by the pressure match.
